Recorded claim:
The address-book toolbar removal made Import harder to find and was followed by restoring booksPaneImport. Tests now use the actual visible button and popup activation. Followup296 removed a click on hidden saveEditButton from test_type_selection; the author did not know why its preexisting failure first appeared with this landing. Model the displayed editing state before clicking a control, and do not infer a causal explanation beyond the evidence.
